name: Colombian Andes
about: Rain is bimodal — two drier windows (Dec–Feb, Jun–Aug) bracket two wetter ones (Mar–May, Sep–Nov), with October the wettest month of the year.
overview: Colombia's coffee-growing heartland and its two biggest cities, Bogotá and Medellín — cool mountain air, cloud forests, and a genuine cycling and coffee culture.
costOverview: Coffee-region towns and Medellín street food stay very cheap — the exceptions are guided treks and the growing crop of boutique finca hotels.
